text.s01: You're locked in your room. Your friend's outside. Then the power cuts.
text.s03: You try a candle. From down there, it's barely a glow.
text.s04: You find a tiny bulb and borrow the toy car's batteries. One flash. Then it's dead.
text.s05: Six volts for a three-volt bulb. You grab the spare, match the voltage, and add a switch.
text.s06: It lights up your desk. How do you aim it? Then you spot your physics notes.
text.s07: Light's electric field makes electrons in the metal wiggle. Together, they produce the reflected wave.
text.s08: You line a bowl with foil. Move the bulb a little... and the spot tightens.
text.s09: Two flashes. He stops. Looks up.
